dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature with a near-vertical descent from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a broad pixel radius, lacking acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour, approximately 70-80 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin base width is approximately 1.2 to 1.4 times the vertical height from base to apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Numerous small, circular depigmented white spots and pockmark-like pitting distributed across the dorsal surface and fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced granular skin texture and dense white speckling concentrated on the dorsal fin and upper peduncle region.
